id.label: id
id.help: Items and other categories name the category by this id. Without a namespace it gets the project's.

name.label: name
name.help: The title in the item browser. Unset: the id.

icon.label: icon
icon.help: The item shown for the category. Unset: minecraft:stone.

priority.label: priority
priority.help: Lower values come first; equal ones are sorted by id. Default: 0.

hidden.label: hidden
hidden.help: Leaves the category off the main page, e.g. one only opened from another category.

source.label: source
source.help: Where the members come from. Several sources are appended in order.

list.label: list
list.help: Item ids and #category references, in this order.

list.label: list
list.help: An item id, or a category id with # in front to nest it.

regex.label: regex
regex.help: Every item (vanilla too) whose full id matches.

regex.label: regex
regex.help: One or more regular expressions over the whole item id.

ignoreVanilla.label: ignore_vanilla
ignoreVanilla.help: Keeps only custom items. Default: on.

category.label: Category
category.description: Adds the item to categories of the /ce item browser, after their own members.
